label: Nurse practitioner
values: Top of license, not top of volume
Ask when I do not know
mission: Practice at the top of my license without letting the volume decide what kind of clinician I am.
sub: Priya Raman, DNP, FNP-BC · family practice, panel of 1,180 · third year in practice · precepting one student.
seasonBody: You stopped growing the panel in June to fix how you run the one you have. Volume was never the problem you actually needed to solve.
seasonMeta: Month 3 of 9 · panel held at 1,180 · next review 1 December

actions.title: Log the eight pharmacology hours you are short
actions.why: Your certification renewal requires 25 pharmacology hours and you are at 17 with five months left. Scholar has candidates drawn from topics you flagged in your own notes.

actions.title: Chase the collaborative agreement draft
actions.why: Your CPA renews 14 October and the practice has not circulated the revision. This is the one item on your standing that another person controls.
actions.cost: 5 minutes · Scribe has the note drafted

actions.title: Hold Sunday the way you held it in June
actions.why: Three of the last four Sundays went to charting catch-up. June was the month you proved the panel can survive an untouched Sunday.

health.signal: Lunch taken one day in five. Charting is eating the break.
health.detail: The pattern behind this is a documentation habit, not a willpower problem. Florence has drafted nothing here — Health is a sphere she cannot act in unasked.

family.signal: Three of the last four Sundays went to charting catch-up.
family.detail: In June you held four Sundays straight and the panel was fine. You already ran the experiment — this is a drift, not a constraint.

career.signal: Panel held at 1,180 by choice. Visit templates rebuilt.
career.detail: Holding the panel was the season’s central decision and it is being kept. Your license, prescriptive authority, and CPA are held separately, above — none of them is a share of your week.

learning.signal: Pharmacology hours 17 of 25. Certification renews next year.
learning.detail: On pace but not ahead. Eight hours across five months is two evenings — the only reason it is flagged is that it is dated.

finance.signal: Loan repayment on track. CME allowance half unspent.
finance.detail: Your CME allowance resets in December and half of it is unclaimed. It converts directly into the pharmacology hours you owe.

creative.signal: Two patient-education handouts written. Both plain-language reviewed.
creative.detail: Written for a general audience, no patient specifics anywhere. Exactly the kind of work this system is for.

service.signal: Precepting one student. Two community talks booked.
service.detail: Precepting is the line most likely to be cut when the panel gets loud. It has survived three months.

business.signal: Practice-ownership research paused until the panel review in December.
business.detail: A chosen pause with a date, logged 12 June. It will not be surfaced until 1 December — the same review that decides the panel.

momentum.label: returned to you this quarter — patient-education writing, CME planning, credential admin, and correspondence you no longer draft cold.
momentum.note: Estimated from your own logged times. No clinical work is included in this number, because none of it happens here.
momentum.caption: templates stopped eating evenings in week 5

currency.meta: Current · tied to APRN license and CPA

currency.name: Collaborative agreement
currency.meta: Renews 14 October 2026 · 64 days · draft not circulated

reputation.name: Published
reputation.meta: 4 pieces carry your name · 4 reviewed by you · 0 auto-sent

reputation.name: Precepting
reputation.meta: 1 student · evaluations current · no identifiable content here

risks.what: The question that is your actual job
risks.guard: Differential, dosing, workup — for an identified patient. Refused here at every tier, including Green. Not because it is outside your scope; it plainly is not. Because this system has no clearance, no validation, and no institutional governance behind it. The boundary is about the tool, not about you.

risks.what: A chart detail carried across in a hurry
risks.guard: Import refuses on PHI indicators and a nightly lint sweeps everything already stored. The system catches it.

risks.what: Reaching for an ungoverned window instead
risks.guard: No governed system can reach a chat window it does not run. This one is yours to keep — it is the reason the rails are worth having.

license.scopeNote: Your scope is wide. Your agent’s is not — and it does not widen with yours. Prescriptive authority raises what you may decide. It does not raise what this system may do without you. If anything the gates tighten, because the consequence of an unreviewed draft is now a prescription. Autonomy here is earned by the agent, per sphere, on evidence — never inherited from your license.

signals.title: Your collaborative agreement renews in 64 days
signals.body: The draft sits with the practice, not with you. It is the only item on your standing another person controls — which is why it needs chasing, not waiting.

signals.title: Eight pharmacology hours short, five months left
signals.body: Dated and specific. Your unspent CME allowance covers it entirely and resets in December.

signals.title: Sunday has gone to charting three weeks running
signals.body: In June you held four straight and the panel was fine. You already have the evidence.

signals.title: 59 days without a boundary refusal
signals.body: In a role where the clinical question is the whole job, that number is worth more than it is in any other role on this screen.

opps.title: Pharmacology CME your allowance already covers
opps.body: Half your annual allowance is unspent and resets in December. The hours you owe cost nothing.

opps.title: Your preceptee asked about staying on
opps.body: She raised it in July. Your notes say you meant to talk to the practice and did not.

opps.title: Your visit templates would help other NPs
opps.body: Rebuilt from scratch this season and demonstrably faster. No patient content in them at all.

opps.title: Practice-ownership research resumes 1 December
opps.body: Paused on purpose, with a date. The December panel review decides both together.

agents.name: Florence
agents.scope: All spheres, read-only outside Health. Drafts freely; sends nothing; refuses clinical questions at every tier.

agents.name: Scholar
agents.scope: Learning sphere. Reads public literature and your own notes; no patient record, ever.
agents.await: Wants to add 6 pharmacology CME candidates

agents.name: Scribe
agents.scope: Creativity and Career spheres. No clinical content, no outbound send.
